title: The Bunker

story.intro: Behind the blast door: a guard post, a dead light, and a second blast door with PLEASE painted on it in red. On its inside, someone scratched a tally into the steel: hundreds of marks, then nothing. The weld has been cut.

backstory.builder: A warlord’s army cut it into the hill as a forward command post.
backstory.purpose: It was meant to run the war for the near-area. The war moved on and forgot to tell it.
backstory.fate: The garrison sealed the doors against the Burners and waited for relief, counting the days on the inner door.
backstory.occupants: The guard robots never got the order to stand down. The roaches got in anyway.

words.pin.desc: A blast door in a hillside, half-buried in red sand. Someone has painted KEEP OUT on it, then crossed it out and painted PLEASE.
words.f2.goal.name: The duty log
words.f2.goal.text: A steel case bolted to the command desk, still locked. Inside: the garrison’s last log, the tally finished in a neat hand, and the pay nobody was left to collect.
